Section 614.1, Code 2025, is amended by adding 3 the following new subsection: 4 NEW SUBSECTION . 11A. Sexual abuse, human trafficking, and 5 sexual exploitation of a minor. No time limitation shall apply 6 to an action brought for damages for an injury suffered as 7 a result of sexual abuse as defined in section 709.1, sexual 8 abuse in the first degree in violation of section 709.2, sexual 9 abuse in the second degree in violation of section 709.3, 10 sexual abuse in the third degree in violation of section 709.4, 11 sexual exploitation by a counselor, therapist, school employee, 12 or adult providing training or instruction in violation of 13 section 709.15, human trafficking in violation of section 14 710A.2, and sexual exploitation of a minor in violation of 15 section 728.12. This subsection shall apply regardless of the 16 theory of liability in the civil action, including against 17 civil defendants who were not liable in the related criminal 18 action, if any. 19 Sec. ___.
